paper.abstract_en: We investigate the quantum Mpemba effect in a holographic superfluid, in which states with stronger initial symmetry breaking relax faster toward the symmetry-restored equilibrium. We demonstrate its emergence by identifying the shifted free energy computed from the energy flux into the black hole horizon as monotonic distance measure. By decomposing the nonlinear bulk dynamics based on quasinormal modes, we reveal that the anomalous relaxation is governed by a dynamical competition in which the slowest-decaying mode is suppressed while the second mode is amplified. These findings provide a holographic perspective on the quantum Mpemba effect in nonequilibrium relaxation involving strongly coupled degrees of freedom.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文研究全息超流体中的量子Mpemba效应，属于全息凝聚态物理范畴，理论深度较高，方法新颖。
decision.abstract_zh: 我们在全息超流体中研究量子Mpemba效应，其中具有更强初始对称性破缺的态更快地弛豫到对称性恢复的平衡态。我们通过识别从能流进入黑洞视界计算得到的移位自由能作为单调距离度量，证明了其出现。通过基于准正规模式对非线性体动力学进行分解，我们揭示了反常弛豫受一种动力学竞争支配，其中最慢衰减模式被抑制，而第二模式被放大。这些发现为非平衡弛豫中涉及强耦合自由度的量子Mpemba效应提供了全息视角。
